2015 colour photo, Hokianga Harbour category; dunes and harbour entrance, but dunes small in frame and 3:1 strip; second choice.
Real Omapere photo but subject is a ruined wharf at dusk; no dunes or recognisable harbour view.
Kohukohu across the water to hills with wharf stumps; dull overcast, not the recognisable harbour/dunes.
Close view of eroded dune sculptures; categorised Hokianga Harbour but no harbour, reads as generic desert; not recognisable as the harbour. Also 'original upload date' only.

2009 colour photo, Opononi/Hokianga Harbour categories, coordinates at Opononi; harbour with huge dunes. Fits reason.
